top: Call unto me, and I will answer thee,
bottom: and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

top: For I will surely deliver thee...
bottom: ...because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.

top: ...then will I build you, and not pull you down,
bottom: and I will plant you, and not pluck you up...

top: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD:
...the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for,
bottom: and there shall be none... for I will pardon them...
They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

top: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul;
bottom: therefore will I hope in him.
